InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSCameraUsageDescri.source: ALAFIA uses your camera to photograph a meal, a medication label or a test strip so it can read them for you.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSCameraUsageDescri.translation: ALAFIA tana amfani da kyamarka don daukar hotuna na abinci, alamar magungunan ko faɗin gwaji domin ta karantawa muku.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSFaceIDUsageDescri.source: ALAFIA uses Face ID to lock and unlock your health information so only you can open the app.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSFaceIDUsageDescri.translation: ALAFIA tana amfani da Face ID domin kulle da buɗe bayanan lafiyarku saboda kawai ku za ku buɗe app.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthShareUsageD.source: ALAFIA reads your health data to provide personalized health insights, track fitness progress, and sync wellness information across your devices.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthShareUsageD.translation: ALAFIA tana karantawa bayanan lafiyarku domin ba da shawarwari na lafiya na musamman, lura da ci gaba na fitness, da haɗa bayanan wellness a cikin abubuwan ku.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthUpdateUsage.source: ALAFIA does not write data to Apple Health.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthUpdateUsage.translation: ALAFIA ba ta rubuta bayanan zuwa Apple Health.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSMicrophoneUsageDe.source: ALAFIA uses the microphone so you can speak your health logs and questions from the prompt page.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSMicrophoneUsageDe.translation: ALAFIA tana amfani da microphone domin ku iya faɗi bayanan lafiyarku da tambayoyi daga shafin buɗe.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSPhotoLibraryUsage.source: ALAFIA lets you attach a photo of a meal so it can estimate nutrition.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSPhotoLibraryUsage.translation: ALAFIA tana ba da damar haɗa hotun abinci domin ta iya kiyasta gida.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSSpeechRecognition.source: ALAFIA transcribes your speech on device to understand spoken health logs and questions.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSSpeechRecognition.translation: ALAFIA tana fassara magana ku a cikin na'ura domin fahimtar bayanan lafiya da tambayoyi da aka faɗi.

Localizable.xcstrings::Try adjusting you.source: Try adjusting your search term or increasing the date range.
Localizable.xcstrings::Try adjusting you.translation: Gwada daidaita kalmar bincikeka ko karuwa da jerin kwanaki.

Localizable.xcstrings::Unlock the full A.source: Unlock the full ALAFIA experience across every device.
Localizable.xcstrings::Unlock the full A.translation: Buɗe cikakken karantin ALAFIA a kowane na'ura.

Localizable.xcstrings::Upload a lab repo.source: Upload a lab report, medication list or flowsheet. Nothing is added to your records until you review it and choose Import.
Localizable.xcstrings::Upload a lab repo.translation: Loda rahoton gwaje, jerin magungunan ko takaitaccen bayani. Ba a ƙara wani abu ga bayananku har sai kun duba kuma kun zaɓi Shiga.

Localizable.xcstrings::We sent a link to.source: We sent a link to %@. Open it, then come back and tap Continue.
Localizable.xcstrings::We sent a link to.translation: Mun aika haɗi zuwa %@. Buɗe shi, sannan koma da taɓa Ci gaba.

Localizable.xcstrings::What are you grat.source: What are you grateful for today?

Localizable.xcstrings::What never reache.translation: Abin da ba ya isa mai ciwon

Localizable.xcstrings::What reaches the.translation: Abin da ya isa mai ciwon

Localizable.xcstrings::You are never ide.source: You are never identified to an AI provider
Localizable.xcstrings::You are never ide.translation: Ba a tayyade ka ga AI mai aiki

Localizable.xcstrings::You regularly log.source: You regularly log %1$lld medication%2$@ that aren’t on this list
Localizable.xcstrings::You regularly log.translation: Kana shiga %1$lld magungunan%2$@ da ba su kan jerin nan

Localizable.xcstrings::Your current pass.source: Your current password keeps working until you do.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your current pass.translation: Kalmar sirrinka ta yanzu tana aiki har sai ka yi.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your data is prot.source: Your data is protected according to applicable healthcare privacy regulations.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your data is prot.translation: Bayananinka an karya su bisa ƙa'idodin sirrin lafiya da suka dace.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your lab results.source: Your lab results will appear here as charts once data is available.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your lab results.translation: Sakamakon gwajin ka za su bayyana nan a matsayin zane-zane da zarar bayanai suke akwai.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your limits are u.source: Your limits are unchanged — they already assume your usual treatment. What changes is the day's balance.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your limits are u.translation: Iyakokin ka ba su canja — sun riga sun ɗauka jiyya na gida. Abin da ya canja shine ma'auni na jiya.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your own health r.source: Your own health record, meals and tracking live in the patient view.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your own health r.translation: Rikodin lafiyarka na kaninka, abinci da bincike suna zaune a gidan mai amfani.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your session expi.source: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your session expi.translation: Lokacin ka ƙare. Da fatan ka shiga bayan.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your wellness sco.source: Your wellness score will appear here once calculated.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your wellness sco.translation: Makin lafiyarka za ya bayyana nan da zaur an ƙididdige shi.

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. I ate jollof.source: e.g. I ate jollof rice and took my 10mg lisinopril
Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. I ate jollof.translation: misali na ci jollof shinkafa da ɗauki 10mg lisinopril

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. bad knees, l.source: e.g. bad knees, lower back pain

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. beans in pal.source: e.g. beans in palm oil; grilled chicken
Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. beans in pal.translation: misali wake a mai palme; kaji da aka grille

Localizable.xcstrings::↑ aim for · ↓ sta.source: ↑ aim for · ↓ stay under. Guidance from your biology & conditions — not medical advice.
Localizable.xcstrings::↑ aim for · ↓ sta.translation: ↑ niyya · ↓ tsaya ƙasa. Jagora daga jiki & yanayi — ba shawarar likita ba.
